name: Companies House search (Find and update company information)
what: Look up any UK company, including those in Northern Ireland, with its officers, persons with significant control (PSCs), filed accounts, charges and full filing history back to the 1980s for many firms.
note: Information is shown as filed. Companies House began verifying the identities of directors and PSCs in November 2025; older filings were not checked. Use the advanced search to filter by name, location, incorporation date or company type.

name: Companies House API
what: Pull company profiles, officers, PSCs, filing histories and charges by script, including searches for every appointment held by an officer.
note: Needs a free API key; rate limits apply.

name: Companies House PSC bulk data
what: Download a daily snapshot of the persons with significant control register, the people and firms said to own or control UK companies.
note: Large JSON files. PSC entries are self-declared and often incomplete or show another company as the controller.

name: Register of Overseas Entities
what: Find out how foreign companies that own UK land must declare their beneficial owners; the entities themselves are searchable in the normal Companies House search.
note: This page is the guidance collection. Information about trusts behind an entity is not public and must be requested from Companies House with a reason.

name: Search for disqualified company directors
what: Check whether someone has been banned from running UK companies, and for how long.
run_by: Companies House and the Insolvency Service (UK government)

name: The Gazette insolvency notices
what: Search official notices of company liquidations, administrations, winding-up petitions and strikings-off, with dates and appointed insolvency practitioners.
run_by: The Gazette (The Stationery Office for the UK government)
note: The Gazette also prints notices about personal bankruptcies; use the company notices for company stories.

name: Charity Commission register of charities
what: Look up charities in England and Wales with their trustees, income and spending, annual accounts, and any regulatory action.
run_by: Charity Commission for England and Wales
note: Full accounts are published only for charities with income over £25,000.

name: OSCR Scottish Charity Register
what: Look up Scottish charities with their purposes, governing documents, income, spending and annual accounts.
run_by: Office of the Scottish Charity Regulator (OSCR)

name: Charity Commission for Northern Ireland register
what: Look up Northern Ireland charities with their trustees, finances and annual reports.

name: FCA Financial Services Register
what: Check whether a firm or individual is authorised to do financial business in the UK, what they are allowed to do, and any disciplinary history.
note: The page relies on scripts and can be slow.

name: Jersey Financial Services Commission registry
what: Search companies, partnerships and other entities registered in Jersey, a Crown Dependency with its own company register.
note: Basic entity details are free; filed documents may carry a fee. Beneficial ownership details are not publicly searchable.

name: Guernsey Registry
what: Search companies, foundations and other entities registered in Guernsey, a Crown Dependency with its own company register.
note: The site returned a maintenance page to our checker on 23 Nov 2026. Basic searches are free; documents carry fees.

name: Isle of Man Companies Registry
what: Search companies registered in the Isle of Man, a Crown Dependency, and order their filed documents.
note: Searches are free; copies of documents are charged.

name: OpenCorporates
what: Search UK companies alongside registries from 140+ other jurisdictions, useful for following a company or officer across borders, including the Crown Dependencies where covered.
note: Free to search; bulk data and API are paid except for journalists and NGOs who apply.

name: Electoral Commission donations and loans search
what: Search reported donations and loans to UK political parties, MPs, candidates and campaigners, plus party accounts and election spending returns.
note: Parties report quarterly; donations to a party under £11,180 are not reported centrally. Northern Ireland donor details are published only from July 2017.

name: Register of Members' Financial Interests (House of Commons)
what: See MPs' declared second jobs, gifts, overseas trips, donations, shareholdings and property.
run_by: House of Commons (Parliamentary Commissioner for Standards)
note: Parliament's site sits behind a bot check that blocked our checker; loads in a browser. The same register is available as data from the Register of Interests API (interests-api.parliament.uk).

name: Register of Lords' Interests
what: See peers' declared directorships, paid work, shareholdings, gifts and visits.
run_by: House of Lords (Lords Commissioner for Standards)
note: Parliament's site sits behind a bot check that blocked our checker; loads in a browser.

name: Register of All-Party Parliamentary Groups
what: See every all-party parliamentary group, its officers, who runs its secretariat and which companies or charities give it money or help.
run_by: House of Commons (Parliamentary Commissioner for Standards)
note: Parliament's site sits behind a bot check that blocked our checker; loads in a browser.

name: Register of Consultant Lobbyists
what: Search lobbying firms registered in the UK and the clients they declared each quarter.
run_by: Office of the Registrar of Consultant Lobbyists (ORCL)
note: Covers only third-party lobbyists who contact ministers or permanent secretaries; in-house lobbyists are not on it.

name: Ministers' transparency publications (Cabinet Office)
what: Find quarterly lists of ministers' meetings with outside organisations, gifts, hospitality and overseas travel.
note: Releases are often months late and give only the organisation and a one-word purpose. Other departments publish their own; find them through GOV.UK's transparency search.

name: List of Ministers' Interests
what: See the interests ministers have declared under the Ministerial Code, including those of close family that could conflict with their role.
run_by: Cabinet Office and Independent Adviser on Ministerial Standards
note: Published only a few times a year.

name: Advisory Committee on Business Appointments (ACOBA)
what: Read the advice letters on jobs taken by former ministers and senior civil servants after leaving government, with the conditions attached.
note: Advice is published only once the appointment is announced or taken up, and ACOBA has no power to block jobs.

name: Foreign Influence Registration Scheme: public register guidance
what: Learn which arrangements to carry out political influence activity for foreign powers are published on the FIRS public register, and what is kept back.
note: The scheme began on 1 July 2025. We could not confirm a stable link to the searchable register itself, so start from this guidance.

name: Transparency International UK
what: Read research on UK lobbying, political donations, revolving doors and dirty money in UK property, plus its open-data tools on influence.
note: A bot check blocked our checker; loads in a browser.

name: openDemocracy Dark Money Investigations
what: Read investigations into undeclared political funding, think-tank money and lobbying in the UK, often with the documents they obtained.

name: Find a Tender (Central Digital Platform)
what: Search UK public procurement notices, from tenders to contract awards and changes; since February 2025 this is the central platform for notices under the Procurement Act 2023.
note: Covers notices from 2021; earlier high-value notices were in the EU's TED.

name: Contracts Finder
what: Search public contracts and awards in England from 2015 onwards, including many lower-value contracts with supplier names and values.
note: Procurements started under the Procurement Act 2023 (from 24 Feb 2025) are published on Find a Tender instead, so recent coverage is mostly legacy contracts.

name: Procurement Act 2023 guidance
what: Understand the notices public bodies must now publish under the Procurement Act 2023, such as contract details, payments and performance reports.

name: GOV.UK transparency releases: spending over £25,000
what: Find each department's monthly list of individual payments over £25,000, with supplier, amount and spending area.
note: Every department publishes its own spreadsheets in slightly different formats, often late.

name: Local government transparency code
what: Learn what English councils must publish, including every payment over £500, contracts over £5,000 and senior salaries, then find the data on each council's own site.
run_by: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (UK government)
note: There is no single national database of council spending; quality varies by council.

name: 360Giving GrantNav
what: Search grants made by UK funders, including government departments, the National Lottery and charitable foundations, with recipients and amounts.
note: Rate-limited our checker; the 360Giving site (360giving.org) loaded. Only funders who publish to the 360Giving standard are included.

name: National Audit Office
what: Read the independent auditor's reports on how government spends money, with value-for-money studies of major projects, contracts and departments.

name: Public Accounts Committee
what: Read reports and evidence from the Commons committee that questions officials about government waste and failing projects, often building on NAO work.
note: Parliament's site sits behind a bot check that blocked our checker; loads in a browser.

name: Tussell
what: Analyse UK public sector contracts and spending by supplier, buyer and framework, with cleaned data across central and local government.

name: Open Opportunities (Spend Network)
what: Search tender and contract notices gathered from the UK and many other countries in one place.
note: Limited free search; full access is paid.

name: Good Law Project
what: Read legal challenges and reporting on pandemic contracts, including the 'VIP lane' for PPE suppliers.
note: A bot check blocked our checker; loads in a browser. It is a campaigning organisation, so check its claims against the court judgments and NAO reports.

name: Find Case Law
what: Search judgments and tribunal decisions from courts in England and Wales and UK-wide courts, mostly from 2001 onwards, as free official copies.

name: BAILII
what: Search a large free collection of judgments from courts across the UK and Ireland, including older and Scottish and Northern Irish cases.
run_by: British and Irish Legal Information Institute (charity)
note: A bot check blocked our checker; loads in a browser.

name: legislation.gov.uk
what: Read UK Acts and statutory instruments as passed and as currently in force, including Scottish, Welsh and Northern Ireland law.
note: Returned an empty bot-protection response to our checker; loads in a browser.

name: Court and tribunal hearings
what: View daily hearing lists for courts and tribunals in England and Wales, to find when a case is in court.
note: Some lists, such as detailed magistrates' court registers, are available only to verified media users who sign in.

name: CourtServe
what: Check court lists for England and Wales in one place, including magistrates' and Crown court lists.
note: Some lists are free; fuller access is a subscription.

name: UK Supreme Court cases
what: Follow cases at the UK's highest court, with judgments, press summaries and video of hearings.
run_by: The Supreme Court of the United Kingdom

name: Employment tribunal decisions
what: Search employment tribunal judgments in England, Wales and Scotland, useful for workplace stories about named employers.
run_by: HM Courts and Tribunals Service (via GOV.UK)
note: Decisions are published from February 2017 onwards.

name: Upper Tribunal (Immigration and Asylum Chamber) decisions
what: Search immigration and asylum appeal decisions from the Upper Tribunal, including reported country guidance cases.

name: Courts and Tribunals Judiciary judgments
what: Read selected judgments and sentencing remarks from high-profile cases in England and Wales.

name: Prevention of future deaths reports
what: Read coroners' warnings to organisations after inquests found risks of further deaths, with the responses they received.
note: Covers England and Wales only.

name: Scottish Courts and Tribunals judgments
what: Search judgments from Scotland's Court of Session, High Court of Justiciary, sheriff courts and tribunals.

name: Judiciary NI judicial decisions
what: Read judgments and sentencing remarks from Northern Ireland's courts.

name: Serious Fraud Office
what: Follow fraud, bribery and corruption cases, charges, deferred prosecution agreements and outcomes brought by the SFO.
note: The SFO now publishes on GOV.UK; the old sfo.gov.uk address did not respond.

name: CPS News Centre
what: Find charging decisions and convictions announced by the Crown Prosecution Service in England and Wales.

name: Hansard
what: Search the official record of everything said in the Commons and Lords, including debates, statements and division votes.
note: Parliament's site sits behind a bot check that blocked our checker; loads in a browser.

name: Parliament bills
what: Track every bill before Parliament with its stages, amendments, votes and published versions.
note: Blocked our checker; loads in a browser. Also available as data through the Bills API (bills-api.parliament.uk).

name: Written questions, answers and statements
what: Search MPs' and peers' written questions with ministers' answers, and written ministerial statements, a rich source of official figures.
note: Blocked our checker; loads in a browser. The API at questions-statements-api.parliament.uk loaded.

name: Members' Names Data Platform
what: Get structured data on every MP and peer, past and present, with constituencies, parties, posts held and dates.
note: The newer Members API (members-api.parliament.uk) carries much of the same data.

name: TheyWorkForYou
what: Follow what an MP or peer has said, how they voted and what they declared, with email alerts on any word in Hansard.
note: Returned rate-limit and error pages to our checker on 23 Nov 2026.

name: Parliament committees
what: Read select committee inquiries, reports, written evidence and transcripts of oral evidence sessions.
note: Blocked our checker; loads in a browser. The Committees API (committees-api.parliament.uk) loaded.

name: Who's Who
what: Read self-written biographies of prominent people in British public life, including career, education and clubs, back to 1897 in Who Was Who.
note: Entries are written by the subjects themselves. Many UK public libraries give free access with a library card.

name: GOV.UK search
what: Search every policy paper, statistic, transparency release, FOI release and news story published by UK government departments and agencies.
note: GOV.UK also has a public search API at gov.uk/api/search.json.

name: Civil Service statistics
what: Find annual figures on the size, pay and make-up of the civil service by department, grade and location.
note: Names and salaries of senior officials appear in each department's organisation chart releases, found via GOV.UK's transparency search.

name: IPSA MPs' staffing and business costs
what: See what each MP claimed for offices, staff, travel and accommodation, claim by claim.
note: Published in batches, usually a few months behind.

name: Ministerial Code
what: Read the rules ministers must follow on conflicts of interest, gifts and conduct, to measure a story against.

name: Scottish Parliament
what: Search the Official Report, bills, committees, written questions and MSPs' register of interests for the Scottish Parliament.

name: Senedd Cymru
what: Search the Record of Proceedings, committees, laws and Members' register of interests for the Welsh Parliament.

name: Northern Ireland Assembly
what: Search Hansard, questions, committees and Members' register of interests for the Northern Ireland Assembly.

name: UK Sanctions List search
what: Search every person, company and ship under UK sanctions, with the reasons, aliases and dates of designation.
note: Since 28 January 2026 this is the single official list of UK sanctions designations.

name: The UK Sanctions List (downloads)
what: Download the full UK Sanctions List as data files to match against company or shipping records.

name: OFSI Consolidated List search (archived)
what: Search the former Treasury list of asset-freeze targets as it stood up to 28 January 2026.
run_by: Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (HM Treasury)
note: Closed on 28 January 2026 and no longer updated; use the UK Sanctions List for current designations.

name: OFSI financial sanctions enforcement and penalties
what: Read the penalty notices and disclosures naming firms and people that breached UK financial sanctions, with the amounts involved.
run_by: Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (HM Treasury)

name: OTSI trade sanctions civil enforcement
what: Read penalty notices from the office that enforces UK trade sanctions on goods and services.
run_by: Office of Trade Sanctions Implementation (Department for Business and Trade)

name: Strategic export controls: licensing statistics
what: Find quarterly and annual data on UK export licences for arms and dual-use goods, by destination, goods type and decision.
run_by: Export Control Joint Unit (Department for Business and Trade)
note: Shows licence types and rating categories, not named exporters or deal values for most licences.

name: Notices to exporters (incl. compound settlements)
what: Read official notices on export control changes and HMRC compound settlements, the fines paid by firms that broke export rules.
run_by: Department for Business and Trade and HM Revenue and Customs
note: Most compound settlement notices do not name the company.

name: CAAT UK arms export data
what: Browse UK arms export licences by country and equipment type in an easier format than the official statistics.
note: Built from the official licensing statistics by a campaign group.

name: OpenSanctions
what: Search UK sanctions together with other countries' lists, politically exposed persons and watchlists in one database.
note: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use needs a licence.

name: WhatDoTheyKnow
what: Send Freedom of Information requests to UK public bodies and search hundreds of thousands of past requests and the documents released.
note: A bot check blocked our checker; loads in a browser. Searching is open; sending a request needs a free account.

name: ICO decision notices
what: Read the regulator's rulings on FOI complaints, showing what public bodies tried to withhold and why.

name: Scottish Information Commissioner decisions
what: Read decisions on FOI appeals against Scottish public bodies, which work under separate Scottish FOI law.

name: GOV.UK FOI releases
what: Search FOI responses that departments publish as disclosure logs, to see what has already been released.
note: Only some departments publish their FOI responses; councils and NHS bodies keep their own disclosure logs.

name: National Archives Discovery
what: Search the catalogue of UK government records at The National Archives and over 2,500 other archives, including newly released Cabinet and ministry files.
note: Most records are catalogue entries only; many files must be viewed in Kew or ordered as copies.

name: UK Government Web Archive
what: See old versions of UK government websites and social media accounts, including pages that were changed or deleted.

name: UK Web Archive
what: Search archived copies of UK websites collected by the British Library and other legal deposit libraries.
run_by: British Library and UK legal deposit libraries
note: Much of the collection can be viewed only in the reading rooms of the legal deposit libraries.

name: British Newspaper Archive
what: Search scanned pages of British and Irish newspapers from the 1700s to the 2000s.
run_by: Findmypast in partnership with the British Library
note: A security check blocked our checker; loads in a browser. Searching is free, viewing pages needs a subscription.

name: Wayback Machine
what: See past versions of websites, useful for recovering deleted pages from companies, campaigns and officials.

name: Historic Hansard 1803-2005
what: Browse two centuries of parliamentary debates by date, person or constituency.
note: Older digitisation with some gaps and errors; use Hansard for recent years.

name: Bureau of Investigative Journalism
what: Read UK-based investigations into money, power, health and environment, many with published datasets.

name: Bellingcat
what: Learn open-source investigation methods and read investigations into conflicts, disinformation and the far right, with step-by-step guides.

name: Finance Uncovered
what: Read investigations into tax, offshore money and corruption, and find training for journalists on following the money.

name: Lighthouse Reports
what: Read collaborative investigations with European newsrooms, including on migration, surveillance and algorithms, often involving the UK.

name: Private Eye
what: Follow long-running reporting on business, councils, the press and Westminster, including the Rotten Boroughs and In the City columns.
note: Most reporting is in the print magazine; only selected pieces are online.

name: Liberty Investigates
what: Read human rights investigations into policing, immigration, surveillance and state power, made with partner newsrooms.

name: Centre for Information Resilience
what: Read open-source investigations into conflicts, human rights abuses and information operations, including the Myanmar and Sudan Witness projects.

name: Spotlight on Corruption
what: Read research on UK anti-corruption enforcement, sanctions breaches, dirty money and the performance of the SFO and other agencies.

name: Full Fact
what: Check claims made by UK politicians and in the media against official data, with the sources linked.

name: Open Ownership
what: Read research and guidance on beneficial ownership registers, including the UK PSC register and its weaknesses.
note: Its old Open Ownership Register address now redirects to an explainer page.

name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database
what: Search offshore companies, trusts and their officers from the Panama Papers, Paradise Papers, Pandora Papers and other leaks, with many UK and Crown Dependency links.
note: Published newsroom leak database; appearing in it is not proof of wrongdoing.

name: HM Land Registry title search
what: Buy the title register and title plan for any registered property in England and Wales, showing the owner, price paid (where recorded), mortgages and restrictions.
note: Searching is free; each title register or plan costs a small fee. About 13% of land in England and Wales is still unregistered.

name: Overseas companies that own property in England and Wales (OCOD)
what: Download every registered title in England and Wales owned by a company incorporated abroad, with the company name, jurisdiction, address and price paid.
note: Download sits on the Use land and property data service, which blocked our script (403) but works in a browser after a free account. Match owners against the Register of Overseas Entities at Companies House.

name: UK companies that own property in England and Wales (CCOD)
what: Download every registered title owned by a UK-registered company or corporate body, with its company number, so you can map a firm's whole property portfolio.
note: Same free-account download service as OCOD. Individuals' holdings are not included.

name: Price Paid Data
what: Download every residential property sale in England and Wales since 1995, with price, date, address and property type.
note: Covers sales at full market value only; many company and bulk transactions are missing. A search interface is at landregistry.data.gov.uk/app/ppd.

name: INSPIRE Index Polygons
what: Download the boundary shapes of freehold registered land in England and Wales, council by council, to see where one title ends and the next begins.
note: Polygons carry an ID, not the owner: you still need the title number from the register or OCOD/CCOD to link them.

name: Registers of Scotland
what: Buy title sheets and search Scotland's land and property registers, including the Land Register and the Sasine Register.
note: Map search and last price paid are free on ScotLIS (scotlis.ros.gov.uk); title sheets cost a fee.

name: Register of Persons Holding a Controlled Interest in Land (RCI)
what: Find the people who actually control land in Scotland held through trusts, overseas entities, partnerships and other opaque owners.
note: In force since April 2024; filings depend on owners complying.

name: Planning Portal
what: Find which council handles planning in England and Wales and follow links to its online planning application search.
run_by: PortalPlanQuest Ltd for the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
note: Applications themselves sit on each council's own search, with different systems and retention periods.

name: Valuation Office Agency business rates search
what: Look up the rateable value, floor areas and valuation details of any shop, office, warehouse or other non-domestic property in England and Wales.
note: Shows the property, not who occupies or owns it.

name: Who Owns England?
what: Read investigations and maps of who owns England's land, from aristocratic estates and the Crown to offshore companies and public bodies.
run_by: Guy Shrubsole and Anna Powell-Smith (independent project)
note: Campaigning project; maps are built from Land Registry and other datasets and may lag behind them.

name: Environment Agency public registers
what: Search environmental permits, waste carriers, enforcement actions and water discharge consents in England by company, site or postcode.

name: Event Duration Monitoring: storm overflow annual returns
what: Download how many times and for how many hours each water company storm overflow in England spilled sewage, year by year.
note: Self-reported by water companies; monitors can be faulty or offline, which the files flag.

name: Rivers Trust Sewage Map
what: See every storm overflow in England and Wales on a map, with spill counts and hours, and the rivers and beaches downstream.
note: Built from official event duration monitoring data, so it carries the same gaps.

name: Defra Data Services Platform
what: Find and download Defra and Environment Agency datasets on flooding, pollution, land, water and wildlife, many as maps or APIs.
run_by: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra)

name: Ofgem
what: Find energy supplier licences, enforcement decisions, fines, price cap data and network company performance.
run_by: Office of Gas and Electricity Markets (Ofgem)

name: Ofwat
what: Read water company performance reports, enforcement cases, fines and price review decisions for England and Wales.
note: Our script got a 403 error page; loads in a browser.

name: DESNZ energy statistics
what: Get official UK figures on energy production, prices, fuel poverty, emissions and the Digest of UK Energy Statistics (DUKES).
run_by: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ)

name: Renewable Energy Planning Database (REPD)
what: Track every wind, solar, battery and other renewable project above 150kW through planning, from application to refusal or operation, with developer and location.
run_by: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ)
note: Old monthly-extract address now redirects here; the file is published quarterly.

name: SEPA
what: Find Scottish environmental licences, enforcement action, pollution inventories and water quality data.

name: OS Open Data downloads
what: Download free Ordnance Survey maps and data, including OS OpenMap, boundaries, roads, rivers and building footprints.
note: The old product page at ordnancesurvey.co.uk/products/os-open-data now returns 404.

name: National Library of Scotland historic maps
what: Compare historic Ordnance Survey maps of the whole UK back to the 1840s, with side-by-side and overlay views against today's maps.
note: A human-verification check blocked our script; loads in a browser.

name: MAGIC map
what: Map protected sites, habitats, flood zones, green belt, ancient woodland and farming schemes across England.
run_by: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra)

name: Defra Survey Data Download (LIDAR)
what: Download Environment Agency LIDAR height data and aerial imagery for England, detailed enough to reveal earthworks, quarries and hidden structures.

name: Copernicus Browser
what: View and download free Sentinel satellite images of any part of the UK, often every few days, to see change on the ground.
note: Sentinel-2 resolution is 10 metres: good for fires, floods and land clearance, not vehicles.

name: Google Earth Pro
what: Use the desktop version of Google Earth to scroll back through historical satellite imagery and measure distances and areas.
note: Image dates and quality vary by place.

name: Overpass Turbo
what: Query OpenStreetMap for every mapped feature of a type in an area, such as all CCTV cameras, military sites or petrol stations.
run_by: Martin Raifer (open source), using OpenStreetMap data
note: Results are only as complete as volunteer mapping.

name: Geograph Britain and Ireland
what: Find millions of geotagged, dated photographs of almost every square kilometre of Britain and Ireland.
note: Cloudflare check blocked our script; loads in a browser.

name: Historic England aerial photo archive
what: Search millions of aerial photographs of England from 1919 onwards, including RAF wartime and post-war cover.
note: Cloudflare check blocked our script; loads in a browser.

name: MOD official statistics
what: Get official figures on armed forces numbers, recruitment, deaths, injuries, compensation claims, the defence estate and spending.

name: MOD trade, industry and contracts statistics
what: See how much the MOD pays each of its biggest suppliers every year and the value of new contracts, by company and region.
note: Annual and aggregated; individual contract notices are on Contracts Finder and Find a Tender.

name: Strategic Defence Review 2025
what: Read the UK's 2025 defence review, its recommendations on forces, nuclear, industry and procurement, and the government's response.

name: House of Commons Defence Committee
what: Read MPs' inquiry reports, published evidence and government replies on defence policy, procurement and the armed forces.
note: Cloudflare check blocked our script; loads in a browser.

name: Royal Navy equipment pages
what: See the Royal Navy's ships, submarines and aircraft by class, with names and roles.
note: Official presentation; check availability and refit status against independent sources.

name: Campaign Against Arms Trade (CAAT)
what: Use CAAT's research and data on UK arms exports, export licences and arms companies.
note: Campaign group; its data is built from official licensing records.

name: Drone Wars UK
what: Read research on UK military drones, autonomous weapons and their use, much of it based on FOI requests.
note: Campaign group.

name: Nuclear Information Service
what: Read research on the UK nuclear weapons programme, from Aldermaston and Burghfield to warhead convoys and safety incidents.
note: Independent research group.

name: G-INFO aircraft register
what: Look up any UK-registered aircraft by registration, see its type, registered owner or operator and registration history.
note: The old siteapps.caa.co.uk/g-info address no longer connects.

name: NATS UK Aeronautical Information Publication (AIP)
what: Read the official UK airspace manual, with aerodrome charts, restricted and danger areas and temporary airspace changes.
note: Live NOTAMs need a separate free registration.

name: AAIB reports
what: Search every UK air accident and serious incident investigation report, from airliners to drones and gliders.

name: MAIB reports
what: Search UK marine accident investigation reports on ships, fishing boats and leisure craft.

name: Equasis
what: Look up any merchant ship by IMO number to see its owner, manager, flag history, inspections and detentions.
run_by: French Ministry of Transport with the EU and other maritime authorities
note: Ownership is often a shell company; follow it through company registries.

name: MarineTraffic
what: Track ships live by AIS and see recent port calls and positions.
note: History beyond a short window is paid. Ships can switch AIS off or spoof positions; VesselFinder is a similar alternative.

name: Lloyd's List
what: Read shipping news and investigations on sanctions evasion, dark fleets and ship ownership.
note: A few articles free each month.

name: ADS-B Exchange
what: Track aircraft live, including many military and government flights that other trackers filter out, and replay past flights.
note: Coverage depends on volunteer receivers; historical bulk data is paid.

name: CAA space licences and permissions
what: Find how the UK licenses satellites, launches and spaceports, with lists of licences issued.

name: Ofcom Wireless Telegraphy Register
what: Download Ofcom's register of radio spectrum licences, showing which companies hold licences for which frequencies and transmitter locations.
note: A large CSV file (about 50MB), updated daily. Personal licences such as amateur radio are excluded.

name: data.police.uk
what: Download street-level crime, outcomes and stop and search records for every police force in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, with an API.
note: Locations are snapped to nearby points to protect privacy.

name: Police workforce statistics
what: Get officer, staff and PCSO numbers by force, with diversity, joiners, leavers and specialist roles.

name: Police powers and procedures statistics
what: Get national figures on arrests, stop and search, detentions, use of force and the outcomes, broken down by force and ethnicity.

name: IOPC
what: Read investigation reports, recommendations and complaint statistics on police misconduct, deaths and serious injuries in England and Wales.

name: HMICFRS inspection reports
what: Read inspections grading each police force and fire service in England and Wales, plus thematic reports on issues like vetting and custody.
run_by: His Majesty's Inspectorate of Constabulary and Fire & Rescue Services

name: ONS crime and justice
what: Get the Crime Survey for England and Wales and police-recorded crime figures, by offence and area.
note: Survey and police-recorded figures measure different things; police-recorded crime lacks accredited status for some offences.

name: Police Scotland crime data
what: Get Police Scotland's management information on recorded crime and detection rates by area.
note: Official crime statistics for Scotland are published separately by the Scottish Government.

name: PSNI official statistics
what: Get recorded crime, security situation, stop and search and other statistics for Northern Ireland.

name: INQUEST statistics
what: Find counts of deaths in police custody, prisons and mental health detention in England and Wales.
note: Charity figures can differ from official ones because definitions differ.

name: Immigration system statistics
